verdict.rationale: Microsoft Copilot is itself an AI assistant/agent, so it plays the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows only connectors to consumer services (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google services) and no first-party MCP server mode or hosted MCP endpoint, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
